SELECT
u.user_num AS userNum, u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.user_email AS userEmail,
p.up_gender AS userGender, p.up_height AS userHeight, p.up_weight AS userWeight, p.up_target_weight AS userTargetweight, p.up_age AS userAge, p.up_act AS userAct, p.up_model AS userModel,
p.up_daily_kcal AS userDailyKcal, p.up_daily_carbs AS userDailyCarbs, p.up_daily_protein AS userDailyProtein, p.up_daily_fat AS userDailyFat, p.up_daily_natrium AS userDailyNatrium
FROM user u JOIN user_privacy p ON u.user_num = p.user_num WHERE u.user_num = #{userNum}
SELECT a.al_name FROM user_allergy ua JOIN allergy a ON ua.al_num = a.al_num WHERE ua.user_num = #{userNum}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_allergy (user_num, al_num) VALUES ( #{userNum}, (SELECT al_num FROM allergy WHERE al_name = #{alName}) )
mapper.select:
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(md.md_kcal), 0) AS totalKcal,
IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(f.fo_carbs * md.md_portion), 1), 0) AS totalCarbs, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(f.fo_protein * md.md_portion), 1), 0) AS totalProtein, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(f.fo_fat * md.md_portion), 1), 0) AS totalFat, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(f.fo_natrium * md.md_portion), 1), 0) AS totalNatrium
FROM meal_detail md JOIN food f ON md.fo_num = f.fo_num JOIN meal_day mday ON md.mday_num = mday.mday_num JOIN meal_week mw ON mday.mw_num = mw.mw_num JOIN meal_month mm ON mw.mm_num = mm.mm_num
WHERE mm.user_num = #{userNum} AND mday.mday_created_at = CURDATE()
